premise.claim: Graceful scale-down via alluxio fsadmin decommissionWorker lets the master migrate cached blocks to surviving workers, so cached data survives scale-in; the new e2e proves it with the UFS offline.
premise.evidence: results/evidence-summary.txt; upstream v2.9.4 sources show decommission removes block locations and marks last-copy blocks lost (no evacuation); default chart image alluxio/alluxio-dev:2.9.0 predates the command entirely (v2.9.4+).

findings.title: default Alluxio image lacks decommissionWorker; graceful path degrades to a 10-minute stall + forced ungraceful proceed
e2e cannot prove cached-data survival (single-block fixture, random placement, no drain-success assertion; victim placement must fail even with a perfect decommission)
--wait 0s does not return immediately: upstream TimeoutRetry misuses an absolute epoch as a duration, so the CLI blocks >=2min and until workers are quiet (up to the 1500s exec timeout)
decommission target matched by host only upstream; no worker anti-affinity in the chart, so co-located workers can drain the survivor instead of the victim
drain-in-progress is reported as a reconcile error: Warning event spam every 20s and SyncRuntime/health/dataset-status skipped for the drain duration
findings.evidence: code path: pkg/ddc/base/syncs.go early return; pkg/controllers/runtime_controller.go emits Warning event on Sync error

findings.title: PR body claims a cmd/alluxio feature-gate flag fix that is not in the diff and was not needed (flag existed at base)

liveNote: Decisive e2e evidence needs a real cluster: check master logs for unrecognized decommissionWorker (F1), fixture block locations across decommission (F2), and decommission timing vs the 10m deadline (F3). CI logs from July 2026 are expired (410).
